Event

Hallie Q Brown 87th Annual Gala

Sat, Oct 1, 2016 · 6:00 PM – 11:00 PM · Hallie Q Brown Community Center

When
Sat, Oct 1, 2016 · 6:00 PM – 11:00 PM
Where
Hallie Q Brown Community Center
270 N Kent Street, St Paul, MN

Come Fly Around the World with Us” at Hallie Q. Brown’s Annual Night at the Q!

The event, which is a fundraiser for Hallie Q. Brown, will allow you to experience food, drinks and activities from 6 unique locales: Paris, France; Barcelona, Spain; Edinburgh, Scotland; Tokyo, Japan; Hallie Quinn Brown’s Homewood Cottage in Ohio; and our very own St. Paul, Minnesota. Stroll through open air markets, watch painters create a masterpiece, relax in a Scottish pub, and learn about Hallie Q. Brown’s mission and programs.
